title: Mike Vrabel on Christian Gonzalez: I expect every healthy player to play and practice

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mike Vrabel on Christian Gonzalez: I expect every healthy player to play and practice
sources.description: Christian Gonzalez returned to Patriots practice last week, but the cornerback's lack of a contract extension has led some to wonder if he might be off the field again as the team heads into their Week 1 game against the Seahawks.
